questions.q: What does Password Hash Sync actually send to Entra ID?
options: An extra-hashed version of the on-prem password hash, synced every few minutes
The user's plaintext password
A Kerberos ticket
Nothing — PHS does not sync anything related to passwords
questions.explain: PHS syncs a hash of the password hash, not the plaintext password or the raw AD hash itself.

questions.q: With Federation (e.g. AD FS), where does the actual password verification happen?
options: On-prem, at the federation server — the cloud never receives the password or its hash
In Entra ID, exactly like Password Hash Sync
Nowhere — federation does not verify passwords at all
On the user's local device only
questions.explain: Federation redirects the sign-in attempt to an on-prem AD FS server, which verifies the password and returns a signed token.

questions.q: Why does Password Hash Sync keep working for cloud sign-ins even if the on-prem network goes down?
options: Because the password hash was already synced to Entra ID, so verification happens entirely in the cloud
Because PHS does not actually require a password
Because Entra ID automatically falls back to federation
Because on-prem AD is not involved in PHS at all, ever
questions.explain: Since the hash is already present in Entra ID, sign-in verification doesn't depend on reaching on-prem infrastructure.

questions.q: What is a real operational downside of Federation compared to Password Hash Sync?
options: It requires building and maintaining an AD FS server farm, and cloud sign-ins depend on it staying up
It cannot be used with Entra ID at all
It syncs passwords in plaintext to the cloud
It requires disabling on-prem Active Directory entirely
questions.explain: Federation creates an on-prem infrastructure dependency: if the AD FS farm is down, cloud sign-ins fail too.

options: A lightweight on-prem agent that validates the password against AD in real time, without storing a hash in the cloud
A synonym for Password Hash Sync
A feature that replaces AD FS with no on-prem component at all
A method that only works for guest accounts
questions.explain: PTA checks the password against on-prem AD in real time via a lightweight agent, with no hash stored in the cloud.
